candidates.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507

candidates.name: MiMo-V2-Flash
candidates.license: MIT (model weights; verify code components separately)
candidates.chat_template: Embedded MiMo Jinja; use --jinja and validate reasoning/tool modes against upstream examples.
candidates.support_llama: Yes — dedicated mimo2 implementation and hybrid SWA cache.

candidates.name: GLM-4.7
candidates.chat_template: Embedded GLM Jinja; reasoning/tool parser behavior is revision-sensitive.
candidates.runtime_risk: Medium: long context and parser/template semantics deserve an exact-build acceptance test.
candidates.quant_risk: Moderate-high versus Q5/Q6/Q8 candidates because the chosen artifact is Q4_K_M.
candidates.quality_evidence: Official card reports SWE-bench Verified 73.8, multilingual 66.7, TerminalBench 2.0 41, and HLE 42.8.
candidates.why: Strong official coding/agent evidence and mature dual-runtime support; main drawback is Q4 weight precision and faster KV growth.

candidates.name: Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-v1
candidates.license: NVIDIA Open Model License + Llama 3.1 terms
candidates.kv_status: conservative-upper-bound; actual lower because some NAS blocks skip attention

candidates.support_llama: Yes — Deci implementation supports per-layer attention/FFN topology arrays and 253B type.

candidates.quality_evidence: NVIDIA model card provides reasoning, chat, RAG, and tool-use evaluation; no selected-quant evaluation was located.
candidates.why: The strongest dense candidate inside the band at Q6, but all 253B parameters participate and decode compute will be high.

candidates.name: DeepSeek-R1-0528
candidates.chat_template: R1-0528 template; system prompts are supported in this release. Do not force a <think> prefix.
candidates.support_llama: Yes — deepseek2 implementation with MLA absorption.
candidates.runtime_risk: Medium: large artifact, specialized MLA graph, and reasoning-generation behavior require end-to-end validation.
candidates.quant_risk: High: effective storage is only about 2.73 bits/parameter and no direct selected-quant evaluation was found.
candidates.quality_evidence: Official BF16 card reports MMLU-Pro 85.0, GPQA 81.0, AIME 2025 87.5, and SWE-bench Verified 57.6.
candidates.why: Exceptional upstream reasoning evidence and small MLA cache, but the target-band representation reaches the band only via aggressive 2-bit quantization.

candidates.name: Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-405B
candidates.runtime_risk: Low architecture risk, high compute and memory-pressure risk.
candidates.quant_risk: Moderate-high: IQ4_XS is an aggressive dense-model quant; card claims similar quality to Q4_K_S but lacks candidate-specific independent evaluation.
candidates.quality_evidence: Upstream Tulu card supplies instruction-following and preference-training evidence; quant card provides qualitative guidance only.
candidates.why: Useful dense 405B baseline with mature support, but all 405B parameters are active and the 128K Q8 cache upper bound is large.
